summary: the include patterns do not resolve to a single directory
detail: Scoping here is expressed only by file location. The patterns src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.tsx, lib/**/*.go do not share one concrete directory, and Stemma will not invent one, so the content stays in the root AGENTS.md and applies everywhere.
suggestion: Set a directory for this entity in .stemma/profiles/codex.json, or set include:false to skip it for this target.
